availability_audit: Chronology anchor: every battle in this block sits at or after the player's first arrival in Mauville City (Dynamo Badge / Wattson cleared), on Route 110 (Trick House puzzle 2), Rusturf Tunnel, or Routes 111/112/113. Every member below is drawn from work/reference-pools/pool-36.json with gate <= 36 and a source_detail map that a player standing on those maps has already passed: Route 102/103/104, Petalburg Woods, Rusturf Tunnel, Granite Cave, Seaspray Cave, Altering Cave, Route 110/116/117, New Mauville and the Mauville Game Corner. Route 118 sources are deliberately excluded because Route 118 lies east of Mauville past this block's maps. No legendary, mythical, Ultra Beast or Paradox species is used. Evolution items (Shiny Stone, Linking Cord) come from the Slateport/Mauville evolution stock already reached; the Gyaradosite stone window is 20 and the Mega Ring was earned from Steven after Brawly, both well before this block.
plan: Brice is four Steel/Ground/Rock physical walls. Incineroar and Gyarados lead for a double Intimidate into a team whose three main damage sources (Excadrill, Lairon, Bronzong's Gyro Ball and Body Press) are all physical. Water is 2x into Excadrill, Lairon and Claydol; Mega Gyarados's Mold Breaker ignores Claydol's Levitate. Alakazam is the answer the dossier's crack names - 'special attacks into physical walls' - and Focus Blast is 4x into Lairon and 2x into Excadrill. Recorded before play: Bronzong is Heatproof AND Steel/Psychic, so Fire is 0.25x into it and Incineroar must not be pointed there; Bronzong has a zero Speed IV for Gyro Ball, so my fast Weavile and Alakazam are its best targets.
